name: greenflow
description: GREENFLOW — panel & dashboard irigasi otomatis tanaman sawi

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @greenflow/shared && concurrently -n emu,api,web -c yellow,green,cyan "firebase emulators:start --project irigasisawi-a28c1" "npm run dev -w @greenflow/backend" "npm run dev -w @greenflow/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @greenflow/shared && npm run build -w @greenflow/backend && npm run build -w @greenflow/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @greenflow/shared && npm run lint -w @greenflow/backend && npm run lint -w @greenflow/frontend
